description: Query 29,500+ World Bank development indicators for 200+ countries across 60+ years.
name: io.github.cyanheads/worldbank-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: World Bank API base URL override.
environmentVariables.name: WORLDBANK_API_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP) API base URL override.
environmentVariables.name: WORLDBANK_PIP_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: World Bank Projects API base URL override.
environmentVariables.name: WORLDBANK_PROJECTS_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Default page size for list, search, and data operations.
environmentVariables.name: WORLDBANK_DEFAULT_PER_PAGE

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime in ms of the in-process reference caches: the indicator catalog behind keyword-only search and the aggregate-code set behind isAggregate. 0 disables caching.
environmentVariables.name: WORLDBANK_CATALOG_CACHE_TTL_MS
